headline: Bahamas Finalizes $1.1 Billion Bond Issue at Lower Interest Cost
summary: The government of the Bahamas finalized a $1.1 billion foreign currency bond carrying an interest rate about 0.5 percentage points lower than its previous similar issue, while refinancing $332 million in utility-related debt.
why: Sovereign debt issuances and refinancing terms indicate international credit market access and borrowing costs for developing island economies.

impacts.name: Bahamas
impacts.why: Lower coupon rates on a major foreign debt refinancing reduce sovereign debt-servicing burdens.
